answer: A practical defence is Signed utility bill payment history with utility provider attestation. It rests on payments the provider recorded across years of service, which gives every honest agent a terrace that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the gale compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The mesa is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money.
